name: Black Channel Marsh
summary: Black Channel Marsh is a murky mire situated in the southwestern Wetlands, flanking the main road leading toward Menethil Harbor. Infested with aggressive raptors, the soggy terrain poses an immediate threat to unwary travelers and supply couriers traversing the coastal lowlands.

sections.title: Peril on the Menethil Road
sections.body: Stretching across the swampy low ground southwest of the main thoroughfare, Black Channel Marsh is infamous among caravan drivers and couriers heading to Menethil Harbor. While the raised road offers the illusion of safety, the stagnant channels and thick reeds are home to territorial raptor packs. Hungry beasts frequently stray directly into traffic, ambushing fresh recruits and weary wayfarers who stray even a pace or two from the beaten path.

faq.q: Where is Black Channel Marsh located?
faq.answer: Black Channel Marsh occupies the southwestern corner of the Wetlands. It borders the southern side of the major roadway leading into Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is this marsh considered dangerous for travelers?
faq.answer: The marsh is teeming with raptor lairs. Because these predators hunt along the fringes of the swamp, they regularly prowl right up to the edges of the road, catching unsuspecting travelers and low-level adventurers off guard.

faq.q: Who travels through here most often?
faq.answer: Alliance messengers, dwarven merchants, and travelers journeying between Ironforge and the docks of Menethil Harbor frequently traverse the road running directly past the marsh.

angles.text: The marsh provides a hazardous proving ground for hunters seeking to tame or track fierce Wetlands raptors right off the main road.
This corridor is a vital lifeline connecting the port of Menethil Harbor to the rest of Khaz Modan, making raptor incursions a constant headache for travelers.
